headline: On last trading session, Indian stock market extended its 4-week rally as Sensex and Nifty hit 9-month highs.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Indian benchmarks extended their winning streak to four consecutive weeks with 3% gains overall.
Record foreign institutional investor (FII) buying drove Sensex and Nifty to 9-month highs.
Strong rallies in banking and auto stocks helped markets bounce back mid-week by nearly 1,000 points.
Global headwinds including US Fed rate hike signals and an AI tech sell-off created temporary early-session drag.
whatHappening: CBIC proposed draft GST rules to protect genuine buyers from Input Tax Credit (ITC) losses.
RBI Governor noted small businesses can generate 100x impact from access to loan credit.
Corporate actions scheduled this week for Zee Entertainment, JTL Defence, Fusion CX, and Bonlon Industries.
Analyst commentary highlighted persistent macro risks for India despite recent drops in crude oil prices.
summary:
Markets extended their winning streak to four weeks with Sensex and Nifty hitting nine-month highs on record FII buying.
Mid-week gains were driven by strong buying in auto and banking shares despite global AI sell-off pressures.
Trading is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 23 November 2026.
